metadata.module_name: Magi Astrology - Geometric Precision for Love & Fortune
metadata.primary_focus: Statistical correlation and precise planetary geometry
metadata.key_difference: Event-oriented forecasting vs psychological character analysis

philosophical_foundation.core_principle: Precise mathematical symmetry reveals destiny patterns
philosophical_foundation.basis_of_authority: Statistical research and recalculated ancient rules
philosophical_foundation.primary_purpose: Identify and activate luck; forecast specific events (marriage, financial windfalls)
philosophical_foundation.critical_orb_rule: EXTREME PRECISION: 1.0° or less for Super Aspects
philosophical_foundation.methodology: Chart comparison (synastry) to find super aspects

conjunction.meaning: MOST POWERFUL ASPECT - Merges and amplifies for specific goal
conjunction.note: Positive and extremely beneficial in Magi system

opposition.meaning: POWERFUL ATTRACTION - Dynamic engagement, opportunity, activation
opposition.note: NOT challenging - actually activating and beneficial

quincunx.meaning: RECLASSIFIED AS MAGICAL - Fated 'cannot ignore' connection

trine.meaning: VERY WEAK in Magi - does not form powerful geometry

sextile.meaning: VERY WEAK in Magi - minimal impact

square.meaning: HARMFUL - Causes conflict, blocks positive effects
square.note: Generally negative, can block magical aspects

critical_difference_from_traditional.traditional_astrology: Trines/sextiles are beneficial, squares challenging but growth-producing
critical_difference_from_traditional.magi_astrology: ONLY conjunctions, oppositions, quincunxes are magical; trines/sextiles weak; squares harmful

Chiron.meaning: Any conjunction with Chiron creates SUPER ASPECT
Chiron.note: Not traditionally used as primary planet; Magi's unique emphasis

Ceres.meaning: Minor super planet, less powerful than Chiron

magical_triangle.definition: THREE planets all connected by Super Aspects (conjunction, opposition, or quincunx)
magical_triangle.meaning: MOST CELEBRATED CONFIGURATION - Self-reinforcing closed circuit of immense power
magical_triangle.effect: Area of life (love, money) is EXTRAORDINARILY blessed or fated

example.result: These three Super Aspects form Magical Triangle of love and fortune
example.interpretation: Potentially transformative, lucky partnership with fated quality

cinderella_aspect.meaning: Aura that makes soulmate connection inevitable

prince_charming_aspect.effect: Exceptional charm, wins heart of ideal partner

activation_technique.definition: Transiting or progressing planet forms Super Aspect to sensitive natal point
activation_technique.purpose: PREDICT EXACT TIMING of potential event

example.synastry_aspect: Couple has Venus-Mars conjunction at 15° Taurus (love trigger)
example.predicted_timing: Relationship blossoms, engagement, or wedding likely
example.window: While Jupiter is within 1.0° of 15° Taurus

activation_types.solar_arc_to_super_aspect: Directed planet activates natal super aspect

romantic_super_linkages.definition: Person A's romance planet aspects Person B's romance planet

venus_chiron_super_aspect.aspect: Person A Venus conjunct Person B Chiron
venus_chiron_super_aspect.interpretation: Person A's love (Venus) feels healing and destined to Person B. Person B's wound/superpower (Chiron) is perfectly aligned with Person A's love. Creates immediate, deep sense of recognition as if partner embodies solution to unspoken need.
venus_chiron_super_aspect.note: One of most powerful positive aspects in Magi synastry

mars_jupiter_linkage.aspect: Person A Mars aspects Person B Jupiter

sun_venus_linkage.aspect: Person A Sun aspects Person B Venus

moon_chiron_linkage.aspect: Person A Moon aspects Person B Chiron

aspect_philosophy.traditional: Full spectrum (conjunction, sextile, square, trine, opposition) each with rich meaning
aspect_philosophy.magi: ONLY conjunctions, oppositions, quincunxes are major 'magical' aspects

orb_strictness.traditional: Wider, flexible orbs (8-10° for major aspects, especially luminaries)
orb_strictness.magi: EXTREMELY tight (often 1° or less). Precision is paramount.

planetary_role.traditional: Planets represent broad psychological functions and archetypal energies
planetary_role.magi: Planets have SPECIFIC event-oriented meanings (Venus=love, Jupiter=money)

chiron_importance.traditional: Wounded healer, bridging function, one of many points

primary_focus.traditional: Natal chart analysis for understanding individual, psychology, soul evolution
primary_focus.magi: Chart comparison (synastry) to find 'super aspects' for forecasting events

step_1_calculate_positions.action: Get precise planetary positions for both people

step_2_identify_super_aspects.action: Look for conjunctions, oppositions, quincunxes within 1.0° between:
priority_pairs: Person A Venus to Person B Chiron
Person A Chiron to Person B Venus
Person A Venus to Person B Mars
Person A Mars to Person B Venus
Person A Sun to Person B Venus/Chiron
Person A Moon to Person B Chiron

step_3_count_romantic_linkages.scoring: Each tight super aspect between romance planets = 1 linkage

step_4_check_magical_triangles.action: See if any 3 super aspects form a closed triangle
step_4_check_magical_triangles.effect: If yes, relationship has EXTRAORDINARY power and fate quality

step_5_assess_clashes.squares_to_love_planets: Person A Saturn square Person B Venus = restriction in love

interpretation.below_50: Challenging, not recommended by Magi standards

wedding_timing.method: Find when transiting Jupiter conjuncts natal or synastry Venus within 1.0°
wedding_timing.best: Multiple benefic transits forming super aspects simultaneously
wedding_timing.avoid: Saturn or Mars transiting love planets

financial_windfall_timing.method: Transiting Jupiter conjunct natal Jupiter (Jupiter Return) within 1.0°
financial_windfall_timing.alternative: Transiting Jupiter conjunct natal Venus or Chiron
financial_windfall_timing.best: Transiting Jupiter forms super aspect to natal Jupiter-Venus conjunction
financial_windfall_timing.window: Exact within days when Jupiter is within 1.0°

business_launch_timing.method: Transiting Jupiter conjunct natal Sun or MC within 1.0°
business_launch_timing.avoid: Any Saturn or Mars afflictions to business planets

magi_interpretation_example.scenario: Woman asks about romantic potential with specific man

super_aspect_1.meaning: Her love feels healing and destined to him. He experiences her as the solution to his deepest wound. Immediate recognition and irresistible attraction.

super_aspect_2.meaning: Emotional-sexual polarity. Her emotional nature activates his masculine drive. Magnetic pull.

super_aspect_3.meaning: Her identity expands him. He brings abundance and optimism to her life purpose.

magical_triangle.meaning: EXTRAORDINARY BLESSING - These three super aspects form closed circuit of immense power

romantic_linkages.note: Venus-Chiron is THE soulmate aspect, worth more than multiple other linkages

conclusion.interpretation: This is an EXCEPTIONAL soulmate connection by Magi standards. The Venus-Chiron super aspect alone is the ultimate indicator of fated love. Combined with the exact Moon-Mars and Sun-Jupiter oppositions forming a Magical Triangle, this relationship has extraordinary power, blessing, and destiny quality. The man will experience immediate, irresistible recognition of the woman. The relationship is blessed for transformation, healing, and abundance. This is a once-in-a-lifetime connection.
conclusion.recommendation: Pursue with confidence. Timing is auspicious when transiting Jupiter aspects these natal super aspects.

critical_magi_rules.rule_1: ORB IS EVERYTHING - 1.5° is too wide. 0.5° is powerful. 0°00' is maximum power.
critical_magi_rules.rule_2: CHIRON IS SUPREME - Any Chiron conjunction creates super aspect.
critical_magi_rules.rule_3: TRINES ARE WEAK - Don't rely on trines/sextiles for prediction.
critical_magi_rules.rule_4: OPPOSITIONS ARE GOOD - Not challenging; they activate and attract.
critical_magi_rules.rule_5: MAGICAL TRIANGLES ARE FATE - Three super aspects in closed pattern = life-altering.
critical_magi_rules.rule_6: SYNASTRY OVER NATAL - Magi focuses on chart comparison more than single chart.
critical_magi_rules.rule_7: TIMING IS EXACT - Events occur when transits form super aspects within 1.0°.
